title: Compression & Trade-offs
topicSummary: Compare lossless and lossy compression, encode and decode a precisely defined toy RLE format, calculate size changes, and justify a compression choice using the data and the user's requirements.
homeworkInstructions: Complete all 12 original questions (30 marks, about 40 minutes). Q5 requires exactly two choices. For toy RLE, each original uppercase letter uses one byte and each count-letter pair uses two bytes; counts are 1–9. Ignore headers unless stated. Show the original size, compressed size and the original-size denominator when calculating a percentage saved.
